audit: erun expose --dry-run --erun-alias erun+test@erun --ip <LOOPBACK> team dev api
expose: api.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com -> service team-api.team-dev.svc:80
expose: per-env wildcard *.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com A <LOOPBACK> ttl 60 (zone services.erunpaas.com)
expose: ingress class traefik
expose: http-only (no DNS-01 broker configured to provision the certificate)
platform: GET https://api.example.test/v1/environments (resolve environment id for dev)
platform: PUT https://api.example.test/v1/environments/{environment_id}/hostname (targetIp=<LOOPBACK>)
kubectl --context test-context -n team-dev apply -f -
expose: ingress manifest:
  apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
  kind: Ingress
  metadata:
    name: expose-api
    namespace: team-dev
    labels:
      app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: erun-expose
  spec:
    ingressClassName: traefik
    rules:
      - host: api.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com
        http:
          paths:
            - path: /
              pathType: Prefix
              backend:
                service:
                  name: team-api
                  port:
                    number: 80
